info.title: ThreadEye AI API
info.description:
ThreadEye AI: fabric inspection assistant. Core inspection and M4–M6 operational features.

Endpoints that return **501** are part of the agreed contract and are implemented in the milestone
named in the response (`planned_milestone`). Every mutating endpoint is permission-checked
server-side and writes an append-only audit row.

All demonstration video is simulated. The answer-key-based simulated detector is not AI;
the local YOLOX-S provider runs trained-model inference. Mode and provider are disclosed separately.
Verification checks reference-video pipeline behaviour, not physical camera calibration.

post.description: Compute the roll verdict from confirmed defects. 409 while pending defects could still change the verdict; pending defects that cannot change it are recorded as not reviewed.
Record and lock the supervisor decision. Exact retries are safe; a later change is rejected.

get.description: Roll inspection report (PDF). Marked SIMULATED with the provider label when applicable.

Claim pack for the failed rolls of a delivery (M5): an English claim letter to the mill, each failed roll's inspection report, every defect photo, manifest.json and SHA256SUMS.txt (the checksum of every file, and the head of the audit chain when the pack was made). Requires a delivery decision to accept with rejects or reject, and signed QC roll claims; otherwise 409. Audited.

DatasetOut.title: DatasetOut
DatasetOut.description: A simulated roll that can be inspected (its answer key is never exposed).

ManualDefectIn.title: ManualDefectIn
ManualDefectIn.description:
A defect the detector missed. Preferably drawn: ``frame`` + ``bbox_px`` (a box in view pixels of
that frame, at the video's own scale) give the exact position and size, and ``capture`` (a photo
of that frame) becomes its evidence photo. Otherwise ``center_yd`` + ``length_in``.
